title: How do we freeze the amended spec, since the first freeze cleared the pipeline run?
context: spec freeze --from-pipeline needs a staged run, and the first freeze cleared it, so paqad has no way to correct a pipeline-made spec and keep its record. Manual re-freeze is what earlier changes did: the new record says the pipeline did not produce it and the HUD may say the High Table never sat, though its records stay in the bundle. A full rerun reseats the eight experts and the chief.
